notes.title: Join our Discord!
notes.content:
Hey Dream Doctors 💊

We’ve just opened the official Discord server for Doctor Dreams Simulator!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775270/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator"][/dynamiclink]


This is the best place if you want to:      - Share your feedback and bug reports from the demo      - Suggest new ideas for the game and discuss mechanics      - Chat directly with the developer and other community members      - Get exclusive sneak peeks, news and development updatesYour voice can really help shape the game — every suggestion and comment matters!

 If you enjoyed the demo or just want to follow the project closely, this is the place to be.



👉 Join us here: Doctor Dreams Simulator Discord  



👉 New Demo: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900630/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator_Demo"][/dynamiclink]👉 Trailer: 

[previewyoutube="_qMQ9jWEBc4;full"][/previewyoutube]For us, the community is the most important part of this journey — we want to build Doctor Dreams Simulator together with you.
